job_summary.text: We are looking for a Backend Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs. The ideal candidate should have strong Python programming skills, experience with modern backend frameworks, relational databases, REST APIs, cloud technologies, and software engineering best practices. The candidate will collaborate with cross-functional teams to build reliable, secure, and high-performance applications.

key_responsibilities.text: Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable backend applications.
Develop RESTful APIs using Python and modern backend frameworks.
Design and optimize relational database schemas and SQL queries.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
Participate in code reviews and maintain coding standards.
Collaborate with frontend developers, QA engineers, and product managers.
Troubleshoot production issues and optimize application performance.
Implement authentication, authorization, and security best practices.
Write unit tests and integration tests.
Deploy and maintain applications using CI/CD pipelines.
